text:
Ezra Thompson: Hey team — excited to join Redwood Inference as an infra engineer on the serving runtime team. First-day checklist mostly done, laptop arrived but I'm stuck pulling the GPU dev image. Anyone know the right registry and who to ping for VPN/cert help? Also hi! Fun fact: I once baked a sourdough that survived a 24-hour road trip. :bread:

Maya Li: welcome!! I'm on infra — @Ezra Thompson drop the exact error here and I can take a look. :wave:

Ezra Thompson: getting 'unauthorized: access to the requested resource is denied' when running `docker pull registry.redwood.internal/gpu-dev:latest`

Ravi Patel: probably missing corp-VPN or group access. @Sophie Vega is handling onboarding creds today; cc @People Ops Bot but DM me if you need a temporary token and I can add you to the group.

Sophie Vega: Hey @Ezra Thompson — did you accept the Okta invite? People Ops created your account but you need to finish the MFA setup. Link: https://okta.redwood.com/invite/xyz

Ezra Thompson: I see the invite but clicking it gives 403 on the page.

Jordan Park: for 403 on the Okta invite try clearing cookies or using incognito. Worked for me yesterday. If that still fails, ping SSO team. Also for SSH keys the usual is `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_redwood` (private key) when you test hosts.

Noah Simms: Welcome Ezra :tada: FYI for registry access you need to be in the `gpu-ci` group. Ravi / Maya can add you. Quick sanity check to run after VPN: ```curl -v https://registry.redwood.internal/v2/```

Ezra Thompson: thanks — VPN client now errors with 'certificate not trusted' when I try to connect.

Maya Li: @Ezra Thompson send me your device serial and OS version, I'll file with eng-infra and request a temporary cert. Also if you want stickers I have a fresh pack. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

Sophie Vega: Welcome gift coming — sticker pack + keyboard stickers. Drop your t-shirt size here and we'll send it.

Ezra Thompson: XL please. Quick intro: ex-startup infra, been mostly on inference infra and perf. Hobbies: I play percussion and run long distances. Two truths and a lie: I once opened for a local band, I bake a weekly sourdough, I hate coffee. Guess which is the lie? :drum:

Ravi Patel: welcome! The lie is "I hate coffee" obviously. :coffee:

Noah Simms: I'll be your pairing buddy next week for infra onboarding. If you want to spin up a tiny local test env: `python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt` — ping me if deps hang.

Jordan Park: Heads up we have a weekly infra sync on Wednesdays at 10am — feel free to drop in. For quota errors or rollout questions ping #eng-infra or DM me.

Ezra Thompson: thanks all — trying incognito for Okta now and will DM Maya the serial if VPN still fails. Super excited to be here :rocket:

People Ops Bot: @Ezra Thompson has been added to #new-hires and assigned a welcome sticker pack token.
